result.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, blacklistedGuestEmails entries are `.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`, but `uniqueGuests` filters with `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` — the guest is compared raw, so case-variant emails bypass the blacklist and duplicate existing attendees. Mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff.

judged_text: blacklistedGuestEmails entries are lowercased but each guest email is compared raw (both the blacklist includes and the existing-attendee duplicate check), making the comparisons case-sensitive. An operator's BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS entry is bypassed by changing letter case (e.g. User@Example.com against a lowercased blacklist), and a case-variant of an existing attendee email passes the 'unique' filter, creating a duplicate attendee row for the same person on one booking.
